notes.content: [p][b]After gathering feedback and analyzing the core issues, we decided to cut our losses and focus on the essentials, removing distracting systems along the way.[/b][/p][p]Some of the parts we changed or removed are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Removed Twitch integration.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the mandatory use of the console within the game loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified various interaction systems, such as the overload mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the upgrade system so upgrades are now applied automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the loot system and removed hora polluted item collection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed many bugs.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Major Patch 4.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Thanks to everyone giving feedback![/b]

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Override Mechanic, replaces the “purple flash”, you can hold E to channel energy into an override attempt, the higher the override level the better the chances against electric devices you can override. Uses interaction range. The objects interacting with this system will grow as we continue updating stuff. So try things out!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I’m excited to announce the Early Access release of hora, an atmospheric extraction co-op game on Steam. As a solo indie dev at my studio [b]aerraflow[/b], I’ve poured my passion for gaming into creating something tense, fun, and perfect for getting scared (and laughing) with friends.

hora features extremely easy-to-use [b]Twitch integration[/b] and a strong focus on content creation, so streamers and viewers can interact in real time. Of course, you can totally play it solo, but teaming up with mates—and tossing random objects at them when they least expect it—is where the real fun begins. If you’re feeling it, try the built-in party mode with emotes and a curated selection of NCS tracks (thanks to their awesome license) that might just steal the spotlight.

I’m dedicated to refining hora with [b]your feedback[/b], which is why we’re in Early Access. Jump in, and help me shape the next updates. [b]LET’S F...REAKING GO![/b]
